branch_transition.mechanism: simultaneous row-column permutation of the Cayley-Menger matrix

naturality: For every representative, sigma transports the ordered double-residue generator, marked Jacobian sign, and anti-invariant 1/w line with total unit +1; all three-step squares close identically.
scalar_invariant_exception: The (G23,G31) external sextic is scalar invariant, but its three labelled Gysin occurrences remain distinct and cycle with unit +1.
scope: generic smooth loci of the eight sextics; higher vanishing cycles at singular subloci are excluded
